questions.q: By using prefixes, we can write $335 \times 10^{-8}$ s as:

options: Force due to gravity is the same on each.
Air resistance is always zero in free fall.
Inertia of both rocks is the same.
Ratio of force to mass is the same.

A person wants to take a bath and fills the tub with 50.0 L of water at a temperature of 38.0°C. After receiving a phone call from his friend, the bath water had cooled by 10.0°C. How much more hot water at 80.0°C must that person add to return the bath to the desired temperature?
A given mass of gas is enclosed in a gas cylinder so that its volume maintained constant. As the temperature of the gas is raised, what property of the gas shows no change?

An AC voltage source is connected to a 'black box' which contains a circuit of unknown elements, as shown in Figure. Measurements outside the black box provide the following information: $V(t) = (80 V) \sin(\omega t)$ and $I(t) = (1.6 A) \sin(\omega t + 45^{\circ})$. The unknown components inside the black box could be
options: An inductor, a resistor and a capacitor at resonance

questions.q: If you like to allow signals of frequency range from a certain cut-off frequency $f_0$ (about 100 kHz) and higher to infinity to pass through while blocking any lower frequencies, you may use a ......
At the center of which of the following four circular rings the magnetic field is the strongest, given that $X=2Y$?
An electron and a proton are moving at the same speed (v) perpendicular to a magnetic field of strength (B). What most likely to happen is that
options: They speed up, but the electron would be faster.
The magnetic force acting on the proton would be greater.
They move in circular paths, but the radius of the electron path would be greater.
They move in circular paths, but the radius of the electron path would be smaller.

questions.q: The currents in two parallel wires are (I) and (3I) in the directions shown in the given diagram. The magnetic force on wire (2) due to the current in wire (1) is (F). The magnitude of the force on wire (1) due to the current in wire (2) is ....
In an ideal step up transformer, what electric quantity is higher in the secondary windings than that in the primary windings?

An aluminum ring hangs vertically from a thread with its axis pointing East-West and is free to swing about point O. A coil is fixed near the ring and coaxial with it. With the switch closed, the rheostat R is adjusted to increase the current to a maximum before decreasing it again. What will the motion of the aluminum ring be during this time?
options: Swing in the direction of E and remains there.
Swing in the direction of W and remains there.
Swing in the direction of E then in the direction of W.
Swing in the direction of W then in the direction of E.

questions.q: When a pentavalent impurity is added to a pure crystal of semiconductor, it becomes
options: An electrically neutral crystal of p-type semiconductor.
A negatively charged crystal of n-type semiconductor.
A positively charged crystal of p-type semiconductor.
An electrically neutral crystal of n-type semiconductor.

In the transistor circuit shown in figure, the input X may be either 0V or +5V. The output is represented by Z. Which combination is correct?

A ray of monochromatic light, initially travelling in a direction above the horizontal, enters a region of atmosphere in which the refractive index increases steadily with height. Which of the graphs represents the path of the ray?
A ray of light, traveling in water, is incident on its surface open to air. The angle of incidence is less than the critical angle. Then there will be
options: only a reflected ray and no refracted ray
only a refracted ray and no reflected ray
a reflected ray and refracted ray and the angle between them would be less than $(\pi - 2\theta)$
a reflected ray and refracted ray and the angle between them would be greater than $(\pi - 2\theta)$

A candle (Object) is placed at a fixed distance in front of a wall (Screen). A lens is moved between them. At two particular positions, two sharp images are formed. The heights of the images are 50 cm and 8 cm respectively. What is the height of the candle?
A transverse pulse travelling to the right is divided into two portions as hitting a boundary between two different media. From the figure, you can conclude that...
options: The medium to the left is denser than the right.
The medium to the right is denser than the left.
The boundary acts as a fixed end.
The wavelength of the transmitted pulse is less than the reflected pulse.

questions.q: Two wave sources operating in phase produce the circular wave patterns shown. Which point is at a position of maximum destructive interference?
Two spaceships A and B are both travelling at 0.8 c in the same direction. Spaceship A shines a light beam towards B. What is the speed of the light beam according to the captain on B?
A double-slit interference of monochromatic green light was set up as shown. What change would increase the distance between adjacent fringes?
options: Reduce the width of each slit
Use a double-slit where the slits are further apart
Move the double-slit closer to the screen

questions.q: In communication, Sky Waves:
options: cannot be 'heard' close to the transmitter.
are radio waves used for satellite communication.

questions.q: The given graph represents the electrical behavior of two metals Y and Z at very low temperatures. Which statement is correct?
options: Metal (Y) is a superconductor while metal (Z) is not.
Metal (Z) is a superconductor while metal (Y) is not.
Neither metal (Y) nor metal (Z) are superconductors.

An object has radiation spectrum as shown. In which direction would the peak shift if the temperature is increased?

The diagram shows a circuit involving a photoelectric cell. When UV light is shone onto the metal cathode, electrons are emitted establishing a photocurrent. Which of the following changes could cause the photocurrent to stop?
options: Increasing the potential difference of the power supply.
Increasing the frequency of the UV light.
Increasing the intensity of the UV light.
Changing the metal surface to one with a smaller work function.

questions.q: According to the band theory, in an insulator ...
options: The valence band is partially filled with electrons.
The valence band is completely filled with electrons.
A significant number of electrons are set into motion in the conduction band by an electric field.
Electrons gain kinetic energy from the electric field fill higher energy states in the conduction band.

questions.q: One of the reasons that makes the Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) widely used in Nano-technology compared to Scanning Tunneling Microscope (STM) is that ..........
options: The (AFM) tip is kept at a short distance from the surface.
The (AFM) operates only in high vacuum.
The (AFM) is applicable to both conductors and insulators.
The (AFM) was the first to be developed.
